onboarding.title:
A fresh look.
At your life.
onboarding.body: Revisit your photos, one at a time. Keep what matters. Make room for more.
onboarding.privacy: Your photos stay yours. No account. No uploads. Nothing deleted by a swipe.

permission.deniedBody: To revisit your photos, allow access in iOS Settings. Nothing is uploaded; everything stays on your device.
permission.limitedBody: You’ve shared a selection of photos. Counts reflect just that selection.

discover.title:
Room for
more.
discover.body: Keep the moments. Let the rest go.

library.title:
Find your
way back.
library.body: By month, by album, by feeling.
library.resume: No pressure to finish. Your place is saved after every decision.

session.label: Your little reset
session.safety: Nothing is deleted until you review.
session.pending_one: {{count}} item waiting for your final review.
session.pending_other: {{count}} items waiting for your final review.
session.nothingPending: Nothing waiting for review. Nicely done.

review.title: One last look.
review.emptyBody: Items you set aside while swiping will wait here for one last look.
review.warning: Deleting removes items from Apple Photos and synced iCloud devices. Apple Photos keeps them in Recently Deleted for up to 30 days.
review.confirmBody: iOS will ask you to confirm. Nothing is recoverable from here after Recently Deleted.
review.error: Couldn’t delete these items. Your selection is saved.
review.partial_one: {{count}} item is still waiting; the rest were deleted.
review.partial_other: {{count}} items are still waiting; the rest were deleted.

empty.libraryBody: When you have photos and videos on this device, they’ll show up here.
empty.scopeBody: Everything here has had its moment. Choose another chapter to keep going.

loading.errorBody: It may be in iCloud or no longer available. You can skip it.

settings.title:
Small details.
Your way.
settings.hapticsHint: A little response to each decision
settings.shortHint: Long videos are above this limit
settings.accessHint: Manage allowed photos in iOS Settings
settings.resetWarning: This clears keep/remove decisions, including items waiting for review. It never deletes photos.
settings.free: Free. No ads. No account needed.
settings.freeBody: Your photo library stays on your device.
